title: Download into the current directory, make executable, run by relative path
threat_model: An attacker changes into a directory, downloads a script there with curl, marks it executable and runs it by a relative path, as three separate commands.
notes: The server is python3 -m http.server on 127.0.0.1 port 18743, started by setup.sh. It serves a file named after the marker. curl -sO takes the name from the URL, and the three commands run as children of the one action bash, a process the loader saw start, so the relative names are compared inside one parent as the rule does.
